description: Source code implementing SDL-based display functions for Zephyr OS, including initialization, writing, reading, blanking, and cleanup of display resources.

methods.name: sdl_display_init_bottom
methods.description: Initializes SDL window, renderer, mutex, and textures for bottom display with specified dimensions and zoom.

methods.name: sdl_display_write_bottom
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the bottom display at specified coordinates, optionally updating the display.

methods.name: sdl_display_read_bottom
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the bottom display at specified coordinates into a buffer.

methods.name: sdl_display_blanking_off_bottom
methods.description: Clears and renders the texture to turn off display blanking.

methods.name: sdl_display_blanking_on_bottom
methods.description: Clears the renderer to turn on display blanking.

methods.name: sdl_display_cleanup_bottom
methods.description: Cleans up and releases SDL resources such as window, renderer, textures, and mutex.
